caption: The drawing depicts two human figures standing close together under a draped canopy or curtain. The central figure on the right wears a crown and a long robe with pink and red vertical stripes and a deep blue cape. The figure to the left, slightly behind, is dressed in darker clothing, possibly in shades of green and brown, and has a lighter complexion. The crowned figure's head tilts to the side, and both figures appear to hold each other, with hands visible near the chest area. The backdrop and the draped curtain above are rendered in shades of red, pink, and brown, with some greenish tones in the background. The colors are muted, and the lines appear soft, giving the composition a textured appearance. There is handwritten text along the bottom edge of the art, beneath the drawing itself. The entire image is bordered by a wide margin of lighter, off-white color.
title: Santo
